reference_overrides.pdr_interface: Use the fixed Qualcomm SoC service locator implementation used by the matching audio, remoteproc and DSP techpacks; do not install the same-named core alternative.
reference_overrides.qcom_pdr_msg: Use the message definitions from the same Qualcomm SoC source as its pdr_interface and techpacks.
reference_overrides.qmi_helpers: Use the Qualcomm SoC QMI implementation against which this kernel's vendor modules are compiled; verify all resulting import CRCs.

governor_msm_adreno_ro.reason: Retain the configured GMU GPU frequency reporting governor from the original SoC source. Android's device patch adds the module omitted by the reference generated Kbuild; the GMU still controls actual GPU frequency.

qcom_logbuf_vh.reason: The active stock FDT has qcom,logbuf-vendor-hooks. Its original driver and CONFIG_QCOM_LOGBUF_VENDOR_HOOKS are present but the reference generated Kbuild omitted the module. Retain printk ringbuffer registration in real minidump.

mhi_dev_dtr.reason: Retain the original MHI IP_CTRL/DTR provider required by the original UCI module. The disabled-config host fallback returns -EIO for every request and cannot replace this hardware control path.

mtdoops.reason: The native MTD logger with shipping sheng notifier semantics is now built in the SoC phase alongside its real pm8941-pwrkey provider. Its single canonical source remains ws/common/drivers/mtd/mtdoops.c; native panic/oops and OEM records are retained.

hwid.reason: Real bootloader hardware identity APIs for platform/country/version/ADC values; CNSS uses this provider to select the actual sheng N81A board calibration file.

nanosic_platform.reason: Pinned original sheng charge/ADSP interface and nano_ops provider; keyboard delivers real MCU packets and I2C commands through synchronized registered callbacks.

xiaomi_keyboard_driver.reason: Shipping touchpad edge-filter provider; original two exports and real OF-configured sysfs enable/parameter controls. Native input diagnostics remain separately under review.

xm_charger.reason: Original OEM charge consumer, retaining actual QTI/Nanosic hardware routes and registration/teardown.

xm_battmngr_init.reason: Original OEM charge consumer, retaining actual QTI/Nanosic hardware routes and registration/teardown.

virtual_fg.reason: Original OEM charge consumer, retaining actual QTI/Nanosic hardware routes and registration/teardown.

ntag5_i2c.reason: Original live-bound NTAG device or IPC DSP interface, retaining real transfers and failure reporting.

qcom_ipc_lite.reason: Original live-bound NTAG device or IPC DSP interface, retaining real transfers and failure reporting.

xiaomi_wifi_gpio.reason: Real SAR input and original wifi_sar multicast/query ABI used on the CN sheng board.

cpufreq_stats_scmi.reason: Original SCMI protocol 0x84 and stock scmi_dev.3 frequency/residency statistics provider.

cpufreq_stats_vendor.reason: Original SCMI protocol 0x84 and stock scmi_dev.3 frequency/residency statistics provider.

thermal_minidump.reason: Real Qualcomm minidump record provider for the original TSENS thermal consumer, keeping the firmware-visible sensor/temperature layout.

source_policy: User-selected source plus the explicitly restored Android hardware port; collect all listed real providers and validate ABI/BTF.
